pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'J'aime la mangue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I do not like fish.
   B. In the morning, I eat bread.
   C. I drink a juice.
   D. I like the mango.

2. Which month is 'février'? (1 mark)
   A. February
   B. January
   C. April
   D. May

3. What does 'l'oreille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the neck
   B. the ear
   C. the back
   D. the stomach

4. What number is 'treize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 13
   D. 5

5. What does 'les cheveux' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the leg
   B. the tooth
   C. the stomach
   D. the hair

6. What does 'la maison' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the house
   C. the ball
   D. the TV

7. Fill in: le ______ janvier (the first of January) (1 mark)
   A. un
   B. dernier
   C. premier
   D. deux

8. How do you write the number 9 in French? (1 mark)
   A. douze
   B. quinze
   C. six
   D. neuf

9. How do you say the month 'September' in French? (1 mark)
   A. janvier
   B. août
   C. septembre
   D. novembre

10. Which little word goes with 'fenêtre' (the window)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

11. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: What does Kamau mean by De rien? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome
   B. Excuse me
   C. Goodbye
   D. Good morning

12. How do you say 'the storm' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'orage
   B. le vent
   C. le soleil
   D. la pluie

13. Which letter has a cedilla? (1 mark)
   A. è
   B. ç
   C. ê
   D. é

14. What does 'Il pleut.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is nice.
   B. It is cold.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is raining.

15. Read: Quand il y a un orage, je reste dans la maison. Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre. Quand il fait très chaud, je bois de l'eau. Question: Where does the speaker not go? (1 mark)
   A. to the shop
   B. under a big tree
   C. into the house
   D. to school

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'J'ai neuf ans.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Translate into French: 'Tomorrow the weather is nice.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'The book is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Write the seven days of the week in French in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Tu as quel âge ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — I like the mango.
   J'aime la mangue. means I like the mango.

2. A — February
   février means February.

3. B — the ear
   l'oreille means the ear.

4. C — 13
   treize means 13.

5. D — the hair
   les cheveux means the hair.

6. B — the house
   la maison means the house.

7. C — premier
   The first day of a month is le premier.

8. D — neuf
   9 in French is neuf.

9. C — septembre
   September in French is septembre.

10. C — la
   fenêtre is feminine, so we say la fenêtre.

11. A — You are welcome
   De rien answers merci.

12. A — l'orage
   the storm in French is l'orage.

13. B — ç
   The cedilla is the tail under c.

14. D — It is raining.
   Il pleut. means It is raining.

15. B — under a big tree
   Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am nine years old.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Demain, il fait beau.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le livre est sur la table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all correct in order; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: How old are you?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
